## Why - `pnpm release` (#7832) creates the GitHub release with `--generate-notes`: one flat list of every PR since the last tag. For v11.24.1 that's 18 entries, and 10 are www/sponsor PRs. - v11.24.0's notes were cleaned up by hand. This does that cleanup in the tooling. ## What - New `releaseNotes()` in `tooling/release/src/notes.ts`, which #7837 can call too. It lists the PRs since the last tag under each public package they change, then by conventional-commit type. PRs that change no public package (www, tooling, examples, README-only) are left out. - Titles and authors come from one GitHub GraphQL query, and New Contributors from GitHub's own generate-notes. - `githubRelease` passes these notes with `--notes` instead of `--generate-notes`. - Preview with `pnpm release notes [] [--to ]`, or `pnpm release stable --dry-run`. - No workflow changes. Output for `pnpm release notes v11.24.1 --to origin/main`: ```markdown ## @trpc/server ### Fixes * fix(server): settle pending next() on abort and ignore teardown emissions in observableToAsyncIterable by @KATT in https://github.com/trpc/trpc/pull/7867 * fix(server): don't crash when a subscription's teardown throws on abort by @KATT in https://github.com/trpc/trpc/pull/7884 * fix(server): report a ws subscription's cleanup error after the client stops it by @KATT in https://github.com/trpc/trpc/pull/7888 * fix(server): keep websocket subscriptions owned through setup and cleanup by @KATT in https://github.com/trpc/trpc/pull/7704 ## @trpc/client ### Fixes * fix(client): send a wsLink request that retryLink retries with the same id by @KATT in https://github.com/trpc/trpc/pull/7889 * fix(client): give each wsLink attempt its own wire id so a late stopped frame can't end the retry by @KATT in https://github.com/trpc/trpc/pull/7892 * fix(client): surface wsClient reconnect errors, and keep reconnecting when onClose or onError throws by @KATT in https://github.com/trpc/trpc/pull/7891 * fix(client): keep wsClient reconnecting when onConnectionStateChange throws by @KATT in https://github.com/trpc/trpc/pull/7896 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/trpc/trpc/compare/v11.24.0...v11.24.1 ``` ## Links None ## Alternatives considered - A `.github/release.yml` with label categories: the labeler hasn't added a label since 2023, and labels can't group by package. - Filtering GitHub's generated notes: still a flat list. ## Testing `notes.test.ts` covers grouping, skipping and section order, and a real run over `v11.24.0..main` gave the output above. ## AI model Claude Opus 5.5
  
--- Open in [code]smith · Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need. ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **New Features** * Added a release-notes command to display notes for an existing release or preview changes through a specified point in project history. * Release notes are grouped by package and include pull request or commit details, contributor credits, and a link to the full changelog. Changes without a recognized category appear under “Other Changes.” * Release creation uses the generated notes, which are also shown during stable-release previews. * **Bug Fixes** * Clarified command usage and restricted release-note options to supported combinations.
